name: r3f-blob

frames.best_why: The blob is fully formed and centred with strong highlights and no cursor crossing it.

tagline: A dark, lumpy 3D form that slowly warps and drifts toward the cursor.
summary: A real-time 3D sculpture: a black blob whose noise-rippled surface keeps folding and bulging, lit by soft studio light on a black stage and leaning toward the pointer.
appearance: A single black, roughly spherical body fills the centre of a near-black stage. Its surface is heavily lumpy and folded like melted wax, lit from above so pale grey highlights catch the ridges while deep crevices stay in shadow.
behaviour: The form keeps warping: noise displacement pushes its surface in and out each frame, and it drifts toward wherever the cursor moves. Moving the pointer over it increases the distortion and brightens the highlights.
search_phrases: gooey 3d shape that moves with mouse
animated black orb for landing page
use_when: A dark hero or section needs a live, tactile centrepiece rather than a static illustration.
avoid_when: Low-power or mobile devices: continuous WebGL rendering and a remote HDR file add real cost.
customise: It is a self-contained scene with no props: intensity, colours, camera and the remote HDR environment are all set inside the source file.
weight_why: A full Three.js canvas renders a high-poly displaced shader mesh every frame, plus an HDRI.

a11y.note: Purely visual: no text, role or alt, and the perpetual warp ignores prefers-reduced-motion, so it cannot be paused or described to assistive tech.

issues: The HDR environment loads from a remote URL, so reflections can fail if the network is blocked.
The blob's dark surface merges into the near-black stage in frames 1 and 6.
polish_why: Convincing organic motion and soft lighting; the dark form loses its edge against the black stage.
title: 3D Shader Blob
